description: This file defines the 'Vacancy' entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It maps to the 'ohrm_job_vacancy' database table and includes properties like job title, hiring manager, description, number of positions, status, and timestamps. It also includes ORM metadata and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: Vacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a job vacancy in the recruitment system, with properties for job information, managerial assignment, status, publication, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the vacancy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the vacancy.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the associated JobTitle entity.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with this vacancy.

methods.name: getHiringManager
methods.description: Returns the hiring manager, which may be null.

methods.name: setHiringManager
methods.description: Assigns a hiring manager to this vacancy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the vacancy.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the vacancy name.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the vacancy.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the vacancy description.

methods.name: getNumOfPositions
methods.description: Returns the number of positions available.

methods.name: setNumOfPositions
methods.description: Sets the number of positions available.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the vacancy (active/inactive).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the vacancy.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the vacancy is published in feed.

methods.name: setIsPublished
methods.description: Sets the publication status of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDefinedTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: setDefinedTime
methods.description: Sets the defined time for the vacancy.

methods.name: getUpdatedTime
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp.

methods.name: setUpdatedTime
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp.
